title_en: GTAGym: AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: GTAGym：用于评估与强化学习的AAA游戏任务环境
summary_en: GTAGym is an environment and framework for evaluating and training agents on GTA V tasks. Its benchmark, GTAVBench, includes 103 online tasks across nine task families derived from main-story missions, plus 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks. A web server enables parallel testing via screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic outcome checks. Six frontier LLMs were evaluated, with the best configuration achieving 70.9% overall accuracy on GTAVBench-AGI, though aerial navigation, evasion, and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator for creating RL environments with automatic reward and termination signals, demonstrated by LoRA RL of Qwen3.8-27B on generated on-foot navigation tasks.
summary_zh: GTAGym是一个用于在GTA V任务上评估和训练智能体的环境与框架。其基准GTAVBench包含源自主线任务的103个在线任务（涵盖九个任务族）以及47个基于图像的射击和狙击任务。Web服务器支持通过截图和键鼠操作进行并行测试，并自动检查引擎状态结果。研究评估了六个前沿LLM，最佳配置在GTAVBench-AGI上达到70.9%的整体准确率，但空中导航、躲避和拦截仍然困难。GTAGym还提供了一个可扩展的生成器，可在固定模板下根据用户指定的范围和选项集采样任务参数，批量创建具有自动奖励和终止信号的3D及图像射击环境，并通过在生成的徒步导航任务上对Qwen3.8-27B进行LoRA强化学习进行了演示。
content_en: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. We evaluate six frontier LLMs on GTAVBench with textual task instructions and on its GTAVBench-AGI branch, where instructions appear only in the first screenshot and a harness automatically compresses interaction history. The best configuration achieves 70.9% overall accuracy in GTAVBench-AGI, yet aerial navigation, evasion and interception remain difficult. GTAGym also provides a scalable generator that samples task parameters within user-specified ranges and option sets under fixed templates, creating batches of 3D and image-based shooting environments for RL with automatic reward and termination signals.
